# IT Security Protocol Review and Optimization

This document details critical tasks related to maintaining and enhancing the bank's IT security posture.

## Firewall Settings

*   Urgent investigation of current firewall settings is required.
*   Quarterly investigation of firewall settings is mandated.

## API Monitoring

*   API latency must be continuously monitored, with findings based on audit requirements.

## Database Migration

*   Investigation into database migration processes is required, based on audit findings.

## Encryption Standards

*   Optimization of encryption standards is necessary, following the latest standard updates.
